summary: Czech (CZ) localization of Business Central 29. It covers VAT date and VAT statements, corrections posting, cash desk, banking documents (payment orders, bank statements), advance payments, compensation, fixed assets tax depreciation, Intrastat, unreliable payer checks and Czech output documents. Use it for questions on what the Czech layer adds to W1.
overview:
The Czech layer is large: 1790 objects, nearly all new. Only a few W1 tables and one codeunit are changed or replaced. It is split into extension-style packs, marked by suffix. CZL is the Core pack, CZA the Advanced pack, CZZ Advance Payments, CZP Cash Desk, CZB Banking Documents, CZF Fixed Assets and CZC Compensation. Many codeunits are named "Handler", which suggests the packs attach to W1 behavior through event subscribers. Table and page extensions add Czech fields. The code summary lists only 6 added fields on W1 tables (for example on "VAT Posting Setup", "Payment Buffer" and "Bank Statement Matching Buffer"). It lists no new events or procedures.

The Core pack covers the VAT date and VAT periods, VAT statements and their XML export, the VAT control report, reverse charge, unreliable payer checks, ARES registration lookup, statutory company information, corrections posting (red storno), VAT exchange rate, sales credit memo types and many Czech output document reports. The Advanced pack adds general ledger entries application, automatic creation and update of dimensions, posting groups in transfer orders, extra fields on item ledger entries and value entries, and general product posting groups taken from stockkeeping units. Separate packs cover cash desk, banking documents, advance letters, compensation and Czech fixed assets, each with its own permission sets.

Learn documents these features on pages such as the Core Localization Base Pack, Cash Desk, Banking Documents, Advance Payments and the Czech local functionality series (VAT statement, Intrastat, Fixed assets, Inventory, Unreliable payer). The same series covers VIES and Statutory Statements.
key_points: VAT date, VAT periods and the VAT statement (including XML export and supplementary statement) with Czech statutory reporting setup, plus separate VIES reporting.
Corrections posting (red storno) with Check Posting Debit/Credit setup and a Correction field in journals.
Cash Desk pack: cash documents for receipts and withdrawals, cash desk cases, reconciliation, approval, release and posting.
Banking Documents pack: payment orders and bank statements with import, export, SEPA export and matching.
Advance Payments pack: sales and purchase advance letters, VAT documents, foreign currency advances and control reports.
Fixed assets: tax depreciation groups, depreciation holidays, two-step acquisition, extended posting groups, classification codes, location and responsible history.
Unreliable payer checks on purchase documents, ARES registration lookup, and reverse charge with limit monitoring.
Inventory: Intrastat for CZ, inventory movement templates, posting groups in transfer orders, inventory operations documents and Czech output reports.

areas.what: The largest area (777 objects). It holds the VAT date and VAT statement logic, VAT LCY correction, corrections posting, CNB exchange rate import, registration number management and the whole Cash Desk (CZP) pack. It also holds the Advance Payments (CZZ) handlers. W1 "Detailed CV Ledg. Entry Buffer" gets a non-deductible VAT field.
areas.why: Learn explains the VAT date, VAT statement, corrections posting and cash desk requirements for Czech legislation.

areas.what: Handlers for items, transfer orders, item journals and physical inventory, plus the Czech Intrastat management and inventory document print codeunits. It also covers origin interfaces. Intrastat Jnl. Line is changed.
areas.why: Learn describes Intrastat engine setup, inventory movement templates, transfer order posting groups and time-sequence checks for inventory.

areas.what: The Banking Documents (CZB) pack: payment orders, bank statements, issuing, SEPA export, import launchers, payment matching, approvals and unreliable payer bank checks. The W1 bank matching buffer gets advance letter fields.
areas.why: Learn says the pack follows Czech banking practice with payment orders and bank statements across multiple accounts and currencies.

areas.what: Permission sets for each Czech pack (core, advance, advance payments, fixed asset, compensation, cash desk, bank documents, Intrastat). It also holds extensions of the standard D365 permission sets, a few page extensions and upgrade codeunits.
Czech handlers and page extensions on customers, sales documents, reminders, finance charge memos and customer ledger entries. They add Czech document fields, including the credit memo type enum.
areas.why: Learn explains that Czech VAT law requires distinguishing types of sales credit memos, such as corrective tax documents, internal corrections and insolvency tax documents.

areas.what: Unreliable payer service and management, purchase VAT delay posting, purchase document and vendor handlers, and extensions for vendor bank accounts and purchase documents.
areas.why: Learn says the unreliable payer feature gets vendor reliability status from the tax authority and checks purchase documents before release.

areas.what: Czech fixed assets (CZF): tax depreciation groups and methods, FA history of location and responsible employee, extended posting groups, classification codes, disposal and acquisition handlers.
areas.why: Learn ties this to Czech Income Tax Act rules for tax depreciation, depreciation holidays and the two-step acquisition.

areas.what: Czech fields, handlers and page extensions on service documents and posting, plus Czech service reports (quote, order, contract, invoice, credit memo, shipment).
Statutory company information: company officials, statutory reporting setup, extended company information, report selection, substitute reports and address formatting.
areas.why: Learn says Czech law requires company officials and multilingual document footers on documents.

areas.what: Extended user setup with user setup lines and a copy and list report, plus certificate codes. This controls access to cash desks, bank accounts, journals and posting periods.
areas.why: Learn describes extended user control that assigns employees to users and manages permissions for these areas.

areas.what: Handlers and extensions on job journals, job ledger entries and resources for Czech fields and checks.
Czech Advanced pack extensions on assembly setup, assembly orders and posted assembly orders.
Support objects: document footers, Excel-style format helpers, copy document handler, instruction management and data sync from old fields.
Excel templates and data exchange extensions, plus transformation rule management.
Contact handling and Czech fields on contacts, such as registration data.
areas.why: Learn describes ARES lookup that updates contacts, vendors and customers.

areas.what: Guided experience entries, application area handling, and the feature to replace the VAT period.
Employee handler, employee ledger entry fields and HR setup extensions, used by alternative employee posting groups.
areas.why: Learn describes alternative posting groups for employees.

areas.what: Upgrade codeunits and upgrade tags for the Core and Advanced packs, and a change to the W1 VAT date update codeunit.
Advanced pack fields on manufacturing setup and capacity ledger entries, plus a user handler.
areas.why: Learn mentions manufacturing cost controls in the Advanced pack.

areas.what: A cash flow handler and a cash flow date list report.
Handlers for warehouse journal lines and worksheet lines.
Workflow response handling and approvals management for Czech documents.
A SOAP web service request helper, used for external lookups such as unreliable payer.
Czech actions added to the Administrator role center.

issues: Overview says the Advanced pack (CZA) adds inventory movement templates. Neither source supports this: the Learn page for the Advanced pack doesn't list them, and the related object 'Item Jnl. Template Handler CZL' belongs to the Core pack.
Overview calls the Advanced pack only inventory features. Learn also lists General Ledger Entries Application and automatic creation and update of dimensions for it.
Key point 1 puts VIES inside the VAT statement. Learn documents VIES as a separate reporting feature with its own setup, history and file export.
Overview presents event subscription through 'Handler' codeunits as fact. The input shows only the codeunit names, so the claim was softened.
Small gap: the summary left out Compensation (CZC), which the input documents through its objects and its own Learn page.
